title: tonight-pick
description: The hero pick resolved from the recs pool by the reroll index. pick=null is a legitimate state (empty pool) and must render as such. art_url points at TMDB: the v2 app must NOT load it cross-origin (CSP self-only) - a producer-side cache serves it same-origin instead.

why.description: The seed film that produced this pick ('because you loved X'). Empty = no seed known; the UI must not invent a reason.
